page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Margin notes stand in the right margin, one beside the first lines and one beside the line "Hic erit magnus". Signature "K 4" and catchword "teipsa" at the foot.

main_text.l: Quapropter etiam hortabatur Apoftolus; vt
deprecationes, preces, postulationes, gratiarum
actiones pro Regibus, & quibufuis
in eminentia conftitutis.
Sed tamen cùm domus Dauidis throni differ-
tis verbis hoc loco appellantur, tria illa capita
in memoriam opus eft revocari, quæ ante di-
stinximus, cùm de domo Iehouæ & Hierofoly-
mis ageremus: Domum Dauidis nempe fecun-
dùm naturæ modum, fecundùm figuram, & fe-
cundùm veritatem intelligi pro ratione loco-
rum oportere: Secundùm naturam significari
homines qui fuo ordine extiterunt ex ea fami-
lia in rerum natura: Secundùm figuram ean-
dem familiam intelligi, quia regnum spirituale
Christi figuravit: Secundùm veritatem esse il-
lud ipsum Spirituale regnum, quod Christus
Dauidis filius æternùm possidet, quemadmo-
dum angelus dixerat: Hic erit magnus, & filius
altissimi vocabitur, dabitq. ei Dominus Deus
sedem Dauidis patris ipsius. Est autem regnum
temporale, quodcunquein Ecclesia & inter ho-
mines humano ordine instituit Deus, ad custo-
diam omnis boni ita constitutum, vt he illud
quidem ipsum bonum spirituale, quod in Ec-
clesia disposuit Deus, alienum à cura
Regum habere oporteat. Nam si humano ordi-
ne & instituto obligantur ad procurationem
communis boni; certè ex quo illi in eo ipso hu-
mano ordine à Deo præsente sanctificati sunt;

page.notes: Marginal reference "1.Tim.2" read as "i.Tim.4" in the scan; the numeral is doubtful. Marginal reference "Luc.1:" read as "Luc.i:"; the numeral is doubtful. The phrase "vt he illud" is uncertain. The word "quodcunquein" is printed run together and kept as printed. The catchword "teipsa" is doubtful. The "*" mark at the top right is not transcribed. Scan quality is poor in the right margin.
